title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
short_desc: Foundational Azure certification prep: cloud concepts, Azure services, management and governance.
description: Prepare for the Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) exam. Lessons follow the three skill areas in the official study guide with notes, Microsoft Learn resources and practice questions.
what_you_learn: Describe cloud concepts, service types and deployment models | Describe core Azure architecture, compute, networking, storage and identity services | Describe Azure cost management, governance and monitoring tools
